content.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
content.summary: 1046 ET – Strong growth in Aegon’s U.S. operations seems to have prompted management to consider moving the company’s headquarters from the Netherlands to the U.S., Berenberg says in a research note.  The Dutch insurer and asset manager reported a 19% jump in operating profit for the first half,mainly driven by its Aegon Americas division, analyst Michael Huttner writes.  The group also raised its six-month operating capital generation guidance for the unit by $50 million to the $650 million-$750 million range, while keeping its outlook at group level unchanged.
